admission.justification: Dropping validated authority blocks the advertised first-leaf preview, while treating missing files as generic authorization could expose stale or foreign source authority. The same-request carrier, exact guard and unchanged durable owner jointly prevent both errors.

applicability: Registered first-leaf worktree_start dry-run for a canonical atomic master whose exact series contract is not yet published, and the durable/default admission boundaries that must reject that planning value.
conditions: The existing ensure_master_series_contract owner validates canonical task/topology, repository/source/branch/memory identity and retained journal state before the same-request value is carried.
Only explicit dry run at a genuinely absent non-symlink canonical parent path may admit that value; any existing artifact is loaded and validated through the normal owner.
Preview materializes no startup-owned contract, activation, source ref, worktree/provider/start operation or real-index/content mutation and creates no reservation.
Actual apply re-resolves current facts through the existing lock/journal/source/activation/CAS transaction and requires persisted identity before implementation exposure.
exclusions: Organizational direct-super and ordinary standalone routes, which keep their existing distinct authority shapes.
An unreadable, foreign, malformed, colliding or conflicting persisted parent: it never becomes absence or a synthetic valid plan.
Generic tool-completion telemetry in an already existing ambient observer lifecycle; startup no-materialization is not a universal zero-I/O claim.

evidence: MIK-R47@v1 rules 1–5; notes/reports/260928-MIK-L47-post-sync-evidence/public-proof-adjudication.json; original reviewer R2 verifies F1; current 9 registered public operations and 32 post-sync focused controls pass

statement: The first-leaf start preview carries the planned parent returned by that owner within the same request to the existing parent-series admission boundary.
